title: Which Egg Hides the Baby Dino?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg Hides the Baby Dinosaur? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Can YOU guess which egg is hiding the baby dinosaur? Watch to find out! 🦕🥚 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dinosaurs #FunForKids #Kidify #BrainTeaser #LearnWithFun

scenes.narration: A baby dinosaur is hiding inside one of these eggs!
Is it the purple egg, the green egg, or the spotted egg?
Pick your egg! Three… two… one!
The purple egg cracks open and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
The green egg pops open and… it's a silly frog! Ribbit!
The spotted egg cracks open and… ROAR! It's the baby dinosaur! You found it!
Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
